instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: GuestOrbit Extension Gate manages active guest-access extensions from request through outcome. The Workspace Sponsor submits a request identifying the Guest and proposed new end date, the Access Coordinator confirms active access and records covered resources, the Resource Owner accepts or declines, and the Guest acknowledges current terms. The Workspace Access Clerk updates the end date only after acceptance and acknowledgement and sends the outcome to the Sponsor. Resource categories, decision criteria, and the outcome delivery channel remain undecided; guest-to-member conversion and subscription billing changes are excluded.

output.summary: GuestOrbit Extension Gate manages active guest-access extensions from request through outcome. It supports request submission, access and resource review, Resource Owner decisions, Guest acknowledgement, conditional end-date updates, and outcome delivery. Resource categories, decision criteria, and the delivery channel remain unresolved, while guest-to-member conversion and subscription billing changes are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Manage active guest-access extensions from request through outcome.
key_capabilities: Submit Guest and proposed end-date information.
Confirm active access and record covered resources.
Record Resource Owner acceptance or decline.
Record Guest acknowledgement of current terms.
Update the end date only after acceptance and acknowledgement.
Send the extension outcome to the Workspace Sponsor.
unresolved_points: The Resource Owner decision criteria are undecided.
The outcome delivery channel is undecided.
